text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors noted overcrowding issues, particularly due to large school groups, which limited access to certain exhibits. A few reviews expressed concerns about the balance and depth of historical content, feeling that the presentation relied too much on technology without providing enough detailed context about Theodore Roosevelt’s presidency. There were also criticisms related to the use of generative AI in exhibits, with some visitors finding it inappropriate given Roosevelt’s legacy. Positive comments frequently mentioned the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, but a small number of visitors suggested improvements in interpretation and exhibit content. Staff and family-friendly aspects received moderate attention in the feedback.

windows.60: Over the last 60 days, several visitors have raised concerns about crowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Some reviewers felt the historical content lacked depth and that the use of AI in exhibits detracted from the educational experience, with a few noting that certain interactive features were not accessible to all visitors.
